title: MKT2009 : Strategic Marketing - Global Opportunities - Newcastle University

facts.fact: The MKT2009 Strategic Marketing module is offered for academic year 2026/27.
The module is available to incoming Study Abroad and Exchange students.
facts.quote: _Available to incoming Study Abroad and Exchange students_

facts.fact: The module carries 10 credits in Semester 1.
The module carries 10 credits in Semester 2.
The module is worth 10.0 ECTS credits.
MKT1002 Introduction to Marketing is a prerequisite for MKT2009.
The module's total workload is 200 student hours.
The module includes one 1-hour online synchronous whole-cohort introductory lecture.
facts.quote: Online, synchronous whole cohort intro to the module lecture

facts.fact: The module includes seven 2-hour online synchronous lectures across semesters 1 and 2.
The module includes six 2-hour PiP lectures, three in each semester.
facts.quote: PiP lectures (3 in semester 1 and 3 in semester 2)

facts.fact: The module includes six 1-hour PIP seminars, three in each semester.
facts.quote: PIP Seminars (3 in semester 1 and 3 in semester 2)

facts.fact: The page allocates 60 hours of guided independent study for assessment preparation and completion.
facts.quote: Time for students to complete formative and summative coursework & assessments

facts.fact: The page estimates 65 hours of directed research and reading, based on 3 hours per teaching week.
facts.quote: Estimated based on 3 hours per teaching week

facts.fact: The first summative assessment is a 2000-word essay worth 50% of the module mark in semester 1.
The second summative assessment is a 2000-word marketing plan worth 50% of the module mark in semester 2.
The semester 1 oral presentation is a formative assessment that does not count toward the final mark.
Resit format is determined by the Board of Examiners.
facts.quote: The format of resits will be determined by the Board of Examiners

facts.fact: Assessment 1 is a 2000-word analytical business report on a company, brand, organisation or service of the student's choice.
Dr Sohel Ahmed is the module leader for MKT2009.
The module is owned by Newcastle University Business School and taught at Newcastle City Campus.
